measured_on: live GLM runs (build gateway, served glm-4-plus; n live examples) — HISTORICAL, pre-migration (D-026); refresh with --provider groq

100.note: Groq free tier (verified 2026-10-20): $0 within rate limits — 30 requests/min, 1K requests/day, 8K tokens/min, 200K tokens/day per model (console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits). At ~2.7k tokens per inquiry the 8K TPM cap allows ~3 inquiries/min sustained. On the Developer tier, openai/gpt-oss-20b costs $0.075/M input + $0.30/M output -> ~$0.29/month at 1k inquiries; gpt-oss-120b ~$0.57/month (console.groq.com/docs/models).
